body.focus: Approved ISSUE-de3ab23659bc21fd (bugfix, small): rewrite only the cli-vibe family of src/assets/models/cloud-model-catalog.json to the runtime-verified values — remove devstral-latest and mistral-small-latest; replace mistral-large-latest with { id: 'mistral-large-4-0', aliases: ['mistral-large-4-0-3', 'mistral-large-4'], displayName: 'Mistral Large 4', efforts: ['low', 'medium', 'high'] }; set mistral-vibe-cli-latest (alias mistral-medium-3.5) efforts to ['off', 'high']; keep zai-glm-5-3 (alias glm-5-3) and zai-glm-5-3-flash (alias glm-5-3-flash) with efforts ['low', 'high', 'max']; tierDefaults core -> mistral-large-4-0, mid -> mistral-vibe-cli-latest, cheap -> zai-glm-5-3-flash; summariserModel -> zai-glm-5-3-flash. No other file changes except keeping tests green.
